ticks.note: `start` is pressed: `Stopped` to `Running`. `Running` was entered in this tick, so its own transitions wait until the next one, and `elapsed` is still 0.
In `Running`, transition 1 (`stop`) is false. Transition 2 has no trigger, so it fires: `elapsed++` adds one, and the chart goes from `Running` back to `Running`.
And again: 3. One tick, one count.
`stop` is pressed. Transition 1 is checked first and fires, so the chart goes to `Stopped`. Only one transition leaves a state per tick, so transition 2 does not run and `elapsed` stays 3.
Counting carries on from where it stopped: 4.
